parts.answer: $2\sqrt{13}\,\mathrm{N}$ (approximately $7.21\,\mathrm{N}$), directed $56.3^\circ$ above the $30\,\mathrm{N}$ force (anticlockwise from it).
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Resolve either horizontally or vertically with correct number of terms — M1. Guidance: Allow $\theta$ and $\alpha$ as in the question.
$X=30-34(8/17)-26(5/13)=4$ — A1. Guidance: Allow $\pm X$ as they may resolve left or right. Allow $X=30-34\sin28^\circ-26\sin23^\circ$, angles 2 sf or better.
$Y=34(15/17)-26(12/13)=6$ — A1. Guidance: Allow $\pm Y$ as they may resolve up or down. Allow $Y=34\cos28^\circ-26\cos23^\circ$, angles 2 sf or better.
$R=\sqrt{X^2+Y^2}$ — M1. Guidance: Attempt to solve for magnitude.
$\beta=\tan^{-1}(Y/X)$ or $\tan^{-1}(X/Y)$ — M1. Guidance: Attempt to solve for direction.
$R=\sqrt{52}=2\sqrt{13}=7.21$ N and $\beta=56.3^\circ$ above the $30$ N force or anticlockwise from the $30$ N force — A1. Guidance: Both correct with a correct and clear explanation.
Total: 6.
